title: TCS @1% applicable on all scrap sales
body: Per Section 206C(1H), TCS at 1% of sale consideration applies on all successful bids. TCS is collected with the final payment and reflected on the tax invoice.

title: Revised EMD refund timeline
body: EMD for unsuccessful bidders is now auto-released within 24 hours of catalogue close (previously 72 hours).

title: Lot 07 quantity revised
body: Indicative quantity for LOT-07 revised from 60 MT to 52 MT after re-measurement. Final quantity on weighment as always.

title: Lifting window extended
body: Due to yard congestion at Mancheswar Depot, the lifting window for all lots is extended by 5 working days.

title: Inspection: max 2 persons per firm
body: Yard security requires prior gate-pass booking. Maximum 2 representatives per bidding firm. Carry photo ID matching the booking.

title: ferroBid is live
body: The platform is open for its first e-auctions. Sellers can list, buyers can inspect and bid, and every lot carries a field-inspection report.

title: Pre-bid EMD is now lot-wise
body: EMD is funded against each lot rather than against the catalogue, so a bidder only ever blocks money on what they actually intend to bid on.

title: Anti-snipe extension standardised
body: Every catalogue now states its anti-snipe window on the auction card. A bid inside the window extends the lot by that many minutes.

title: Sealed tender sales added
body: Selected catalogues now run as sealed tenders — one offer per bidder, no visible ladder, opened together at close.

title: Weighment tolerance published
body: Final quantity is settled on weighment. The tolerance and the pro-rata adjustment method are now stated in the standard terms.

title: Festive week auction calendar
body: No auctions will close between the 9th and the 12th. Inspection visits continue as scheduled at all yards.

title: EMD refund timeline halved
body: EMD for unsuccessful bidders is auto-released within 24 hours of catalogue close, down from 72 hours.

title: GST rate change on scrap
body: Please note the revised GST treatment applicable from this quarter. Invoices raised after the effective date carry the new rate.

title: Delivery orders now carry a lifting checklist
body: Weighbridge, loading and gross weighment are recorded against every delivery order before handover is confirmed.

title: Buyer premium disclosed on every lot
body: The buyer premium is now shown on the lot card and on the delivery order, so the landed cost is visible before a bid is placed.
